purpose: Smartphone-accessible synthetic My Day interface and independent device checks; not integrated S01 acceptance
observed_by: Codex orchestrator with delegated React implementation and actual HTTPS browser verification
data_origin: Fixed synthetic task/meal fixtures and the previously generated synthetic Nancy WAV; no real care records
user_direction: Owner selected a smartphone for the next test and requested a web-interface URL first. Exact phone OS/browser and owner device observations are pending.

automated_checks.new_boundaries: Four server isolation/audio-range tests and five preview UI/lifecycle tests

browser_checks.browser: Codex in-app desktop browser over the public HTTPS URL

microphone_policy.activation: Explicit user tap and browser permission only
microphone_policy.storage: Browser memory object URL only; no upload, persistence or transcription
microphone_policy.shutdown: Stop tracks and dispose local playback on navigation, page hide, visibility hidden and unmount; cancel late permission completion

limitations: The interface shows sample data and explicitly states that no plan is saved and live Nancy conversation is not connected.
Anyone with the temporary URL can view these public-safe fixtures. The preview imports no care service, provider credentials or OAuth setup, and rejects write/upload routes.
The link depends on this computer and both hidden processes remaining running. Quick Tunnels change hostname after restart, have no uptime guarantee and do not support SSE.
Browser playback and a desktop phone-width viewport are not evidence of actual smartphone microphone/audio acceptance.
S01 remains in_progress; local PostgreSQL/auth, full role scope, care commands, integrated Sol/voice and both S01 live acceptance scenarios remain outstanding.
